title: Wiley Border
description: Customizable in-game overlays for your convenience
body:
## WILEY BORDER
Wiley Border is a client-side utility mod that allows you to place overlays in-game. The overlays are customizable with a config menu where you can configure location, color, and opacity level.

Currently, you can use up to four overlays that expand across the entire coordinate plane.

These overlays can be used for custom borders, marking zones, or for building schematic uses.


### Installation Guide
Download the **dependency mods** Cloth Config and Mod Menu. Ensure you have Fabric API and Fabric properly set up for Minecraft 1.21.4. Download the mod jar and enjoy!

### Compatabilities
This mod has no known incompatibilities, it should run with any Minecraft version. Note that with **Iris Shaders** installed, the border will be opaque. See [Issues](https://github.com/yourlocaljosh/wiley-border/issues) for more information.

### Bugs or Feature Requests
Want to report bugs or request features? Head to [Issues](https://github.com/yourlocaljosh/wiley-border/issues) on the mod repo and open up an issue! I do check them regularly.

**Created by Klism**
